claims.statement: The suite's wall time is set by a single long-pole file: test/cli-e2e.test.js runs 46 tests serially in one worker, each spawning a real node bin/doflow.js (41 of them full installs), taking 14.2s, and node --test parallelizes across files but not within one — so the 15.4s suite is 14.2s of cli-e2e plus 1.2s of everything else.
This week's 24 new test files are not the dominant cause: they add 23.1s of serial work but only 1.1s of wall time, because that work runs in the shadow of the long pole on a 10-core machine.
No individual pre-existing test regressed: cli-e2e.test.js changed by +21/-1 lines this week and its 46 tests are evenly distributed with no test above 1.1s.
